Cackle
Mother Goose having gone out on her broomstick she has had to delay the answers.

They are not many in number this time, for [Chelsea China](../persons.html#329)’s popularity and [Windermere](../persons.html#1467)’s Wars of the Roses are decidedly the superior articles. [Cricket](../persons.html#1603) is the next to ask the questions.
[Mignonette](../persons.html#1637) and [Sparrow Hawk](../persons.html#97) retire

[^1]: Black-edged paper.

[^2]: This seems to be the only surviving example of a \'Cackle\', one of the circular letters with which CMY communicated with the members of the [Gosling Society](../others.html#104).
